title: Freezing the p–i–n interlayer with a symmetric phenolic compound to achieve favorable vertical morphology and efficient pseudo-planar heterojunction organic solar cells with excellent stability
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04052C, Paper
Xunfan Liao, Zeng Li, Shiting Lai, Haojia Ding, Jinyang Yu, Yuang Fu, Peipei Zhu, Xinhui Lu, Haiming Zhu, Yiwang Chen
A strategy of using symmetric phenolic compound 4,4′-dihydroxybiphenyl to freeze p–i–n interlayer of pseudo-planar heterojunction organic solar cells has been first developed, resulting in optimized and stable vertical phase separation morphology.
